reason: The plan review stopped at its hard cap with round 3's design-wrong findings F19, F20 and F21 open, all of them on card 12 (board-test-moves). The round-3 fixer applied each fix exactly as the review prescribed, and the current card 12 answers each one. F19: newReplayHub, pushPrimeRecords, commitOnOrigin, endEntryOnOrigin and addPushedPair are gone, gitkit.CommitOnBare is created, and fabric's originCommit and originCommitFile call it, so one copy stands. The card names the edit to replay_integration_test.go as a departure from D9. F20: the pushkit kit is gone, and moved rows assert inline over ListFailedPushes and the report's Entries. F21: teardownRecorder now wraps the real pairteardown.New and OriginSeams(HubSeamOptions) seams and records what passes through, with no scripted reply, and OwnerOf comes from pairteardown.OwnerReader with a fixed identity. The card's two Unverified facts hold in the code. otherPairSessions treats a hub with no tmux server as having no sessions. fabriccli's tier1 removelanding test already runs a real teardown over a hubforge hub. OwnerReader returns ParseOwners' error on board bytes that do not decode. The fix in place answers every open finding, so I recorded the ruling as an arbiter decision and accepted the round.
